LATEST CHANGES
v8.6 — Game History with game details, player rankings, filters, event log and Insights
v8.5 — New shared turn timer with a separate countdown on every player panel, plus a compact history button
v8.4 — Game log with the last 20 winners
v8.3 — New player overview with correct counters and icons; Commander damage now lives only on the game board
v8.2 — Commander damage directly on the game board, living fireflies and new damage and healing effects
v8.1 — Tools: five newly designed experiences with their own animations, result screens and sounds
v8.0 — Arcane Edition: a complete visual facelift, a new responsive navigation system and a fully redesigned Life experience
v7.6 — Tap anywhere on your panel to change life: the left half subtracts, the right half adds
v7.5 — The host now also picks a background and readies up just like everyone else
v7.4 — Choose name, color and background before you join — the game starts for everyone once all players are ready
v7.3 — Fixed “Resume game”: the host now restarts their own room, and clients are told if no host responds
v7.2 — QR code so others can join with the camera app, and seats are held for 5 minutes if someone drops out
v7.1 — Brand new “Who goes first?”: the spark jumps between players and strikes the winner — with a new sound
v7.0 — Tools completely rebuilt: D4–D100 as real 3D shapes, totals, confetti, a new menu and smoother player swapping
v6.9 — New animated game setup with a table view, mana lights and a start-up fanfare
v6.8 — Collection value is now shown as a graph with its development over time
v6.7 — Card art as a player background, and all counters (energy, experience, storm, monarch and more) gathered in one drawer — the board shows only what you use
v6.6 — New “What am I missing?” in decks: see what you lack, what it costs, and buy via Cardmarket or Kelz0r
v6.5 — CSV import now understands ManaBox, Moxfield and others with images and prices, and large collections no longer freeze
v6.4 — Stable multiplayer: the host controls the game, so someone leaving or reconnecting can no longer reset life totals
v6.3 — The app now takes a sharp still photo by itself once the card is in place
v6.2 — Faster and sharper live scanning (full resolution instead of downscaled)
v6.1 — The scanner now also finds the right printing: set code, collector number and art are compared
v6.0 — New scanner: fixed target frame + PaddleOCR
v5.5 — Fixed the camera image being cropped: the frame and tap calibration now line up correctly
v5.4 — New card recognition that finds the card rather than the holder
v5.3 — Now scans in 4K and crops digitally onto the card — works no matter how large the card is in the frame
v5.0 — The scanner is now fully automatic: it picks camera, zoom, frame and method itself, and scans on its own when you place a card
v4.4 — Recent searches are shown on the search page · Choose between your phone cameras and auto-zoom in the scanner
v3.9 — Bulk scan now waits for the next card instead of counting the same one again, plus a mode for older cards
v3.8 — Bulk scan: scan many cards in a row into your collection or wishlist, with a live list and undo
v3.7 — Camera zoom, an adjustable scan frame and auto-fit for card holders
v3.6 — A real cash register sound when you scan a card worth more than 50 DKK
v3.4 — The scanner now also compares the artwork image and picks the correct printing from it
v3.3 — The scanner now also uses the artist name as a check
v3.2 — The scanner now cross-checks the card name and handles the rarity letter next to the number
v3.1 — The scanner now reads set code and collector number and finds the exact printing (name OCR as fallback)
v3.0 — Online/offline indicator on players in multiplayer, plus a new color order (MTG colors first)
v2.9 — Reconnecting in multiplayer: you automatically get your seat back, and abandoned seats are released
v2.8 — Move players now works in multiplayer, and seats are assigned automatically and cannot be double-booked
v2.7 — Smarter scanner: score-based name matching, partial names recognised, two-frame confirmation
v2.6 — Faster and more accurate scanning, batch scan into the collection, scan history and flashlight
v2.5 — New look, safe simultaneous taps (multi-touch and online), fixed undo of commander damage
v2.4 — Undo button in the Life counter, faster price updates and bug fixes
v2.3 — Color and type filters in the collection, move players locally, export as plain text
v2.2 — Mana symbols on cards, collapsible type groups and sorting in the deck builder
v2.1 — Choose Local or Online when you start the game
v2.0 — 3- and 5-player multiplayer: your panel is always at the bottom and full width
v1.9 — Show who rolled the die, flipped the coin or picked at random in multiplayer

💾

Backup of your collection

The app stores your collection in your phone’s browser storage. That is fast and convenient, but it can be deleted if you:

  • Manually clear Safari/Chrome's cache
  • Uninstall the app
  • Switch phones

The app tries to protect your data against automatic cache clearing — but nothing can protect against a deliberate delete.

A backup file is your insurance.

📱 How to store the file safely:
1. Tap "Download now" below
2. The file appears in your Files app under Downloads
3. Move it to iCloud Drive or another safe location
4. Repeat once you have added a lot of new cards
